d: Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.

The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself. You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership
q: Experience: 7+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications in production. Not just building AI point solutions, AI platform level experience is required.
Technical leadership: has led a team of 3+ AI engineers/scientist technically (design reviews, standards, mentoring)
LLM application engineering: deep hands-on experience with prompting, structured outputs, guardrails, agent patterns/harness development (planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning).
Ability to work in ambiguous settings: can bring clarity and structure to complex situations
Evaluation: has built LLM evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and used them to gate releases.
Production engineering: strong Python; experience with APIs, cloud deployment, observability and debugging distributed systems.
Communication: fluent written and spoken English; able to write clear design docs and decision records.
Arabic NLP: experience with Arabic and its dialects, especially Gulf Arabic, in LLM or speech systems.
Voice AI: experience with ASR, TTS and real-time voice agents, including latency optimisation.
Production monitoring for LLMs: hands-on use of tracing and online eval tools (for example Langfuse, Arize or similar).
Model adaptation: fine-tuning or distilling open-weight models, and serving them cost-effectively.
r: Own and be accountable for the AI architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline.
Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale.
Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development
Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them.
Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring.
Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour.
Manage the building of prototypes/experiments to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them.
Work with Product to turn customer use cases into technical requirements
Work with Engineering on shared platform work: tool calling, workflows, deployment and scaling.
Ownership: takes outcomes end to end, including gaps between teams, and follows through without being asked.
Trade-off judgement: grounds decisions in business needs and can explain the trade-offs between quality, speed and cost.
Constructive challenge: comfortable questioning existing approaches and proposing better ones.
Team player: shares credit, helps teammates succeed, and puts team goals ahead of individual wins.
Creativity and innovation: solve complex challenges with 'out-of-box' thinking and be a champion for innovation

d: The Fleet Sales Executive is responsible for generating and managing fleet sales business by acquiring new customers and maintaining strong relationships with existing corporate, government, rental, and leasing clients. The role focuses on achieving assigned sales targets, delivering excellent customer service, and supporting the execution of the company’s fleet sales strategy through effective account management and sales execution.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
Automotive or fleet sales certifications are an advantage.
Minimum 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in automotive fleet, leasing, or corporate sales.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing corporate accounts.
Experience in tender handling, contract negotiation, and key account management is preferred.
r: Identify, prospect, and develop new fleet sales opportunities within corporate, government, rental, and institutional segments.
Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline to achieve assigned fleet sales targets and market share objectives.
Conduct client meetings, presentations, and needs assessments to understand customer fleet requirements.
Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of fleet customers, ensuring long-term relationships and repeat business.
Act as the primary point of contact for fleet customers throughout the sales lifecycle.
Proactively identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, including vehicles, financing, maintenance, and value-added services.
Prepare and present fleet proposals, quotations, and pricing structures aligned with customer needs and company policies.
Advise customers on vehicle selection, fleet optimization, total cost of ownership (TCO), and lifecycle management.
Negotiate commercial terms and contracts within approved authority levels.
Coordinate vehicle orders, specifications, production schedules, and delivery timelines with internal sales support, logistics, and aftersales teams.
Monitor order progress and ensure timely vehicle delivery, registration, and handover.
Ensure accurate completion of sales contracts, documentation, and compliance requirements.
Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and order data in CRM and sales systems.
Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and pipeline updates for management review.
Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback within the fleet segment.
Ensure compliance with company sales policies, pricing guidelines, and ethical standards.
Adhere to legal, financial, and regulatory requirements related to fleet sales and contracts.
Support internal audits, reporting requirements, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

d: We are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure & Network Manager to lead and evolve a large-scale enterprise technology environment supporting corporate users and business-critical applications.

This is a highly visible leadership position that requires a rare combination of deep technical expertise and strategic management capability. While the title is Manager, the successful candidate must remain hands-on, capable of operating at engineering level during major incidents, migrations, critical projects, and architectural transformations.

The role is responsible for the overall infrastructure and network estate, including strategy, architecture, operations, security, governance, vendor management, and budgeting. You will lead a team of infrastructure and network professionals while acting as the technical authority for the organisation's Microsoft ecosystem.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of infrastructure and network engineers.
Provide technical leadership and guidance across infrastructure, cloud, collaboration, identity, and networking domains.
Act as the escalation point for major incidents, complex technical challenges, and critical business services.
Foster a culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, and technical innovation.
Own the enterprise infrastructure and network architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency.
Make key architectural decisions across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Develop and maintain technology roadmaps aligned with business and IT strategy.
Lead infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, and transformation initiatives.
Maintain accountability for infrastructure availability, performance, and service quality.
Oversee the delivery of business-critical IT services supporting corporate users and enterprise applications.
Ensure robust monitoring, incident management, change management, and capacity planning processes are in place.
Participate directly in major incidents, migrations, upgrades, and critical changes when required.
Build and manage infrastructure budgets, including operational expenditure, capital expenditure, and software licensing.
Lead vendor selection, contract negotiations, and SLA management.
Challenge and validate technical proposals and delivery plans provided by third-party partners.
Ensure value for money while maintaining service quality and security standards.
Establish and maintain infrastructure policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
Manage infrastructure risk, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
Ensure compliance with corporate security standards and regulatory requirements.
Support and enhance the organisation's security posture through alignment with security best practices and Microsoft security technologies.
Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to align infrastructure strategy with organisational objectives.
Provide regular reporting on service performance, projects, risks, budgets, and strategic initiatives.
Influence decision-making across technology and business functions.
10+ years of experience across IT infrastructure, cloud, and enterprise networking environments.
Proven experience managing infrastructure teams within large enterprise organisations.
Demonstrated ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery.
Strong experience managing enterprise infrastructure projects, vendors, and IT operations.
Experience owning infrastructure roadmaps, budgets, governance frameworks, and operational performance.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior leadership teams.
Previous responsibility for mission-critical, enterprise-scale environments.
Candidates must possess deep, hands-on experience across the Microsoft technology stack. Individuals with leadership experience but limited Microsoft expertise will not be considered.
Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Microsoft environments.
Experience making architecture decisions rather than simply administering existing platforms.
Be recognised as a highly capable technical authority by both engineers and stakeholders.
Challenge technical proposals and decisions from vendors and partners with confidence.
Maintain current hands-on technical capability alongside leadership responsibilities.
Personally contribute during major incidents, technology transformations, and critical projects.
Drive technology decisions based on business outcomes, operational resilience, and long-term strategy.
q: Experience within large corporate, utilities, energy, government, or highly regulated environments.
Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure environments at enterprise scale.
Exposure to cybersecurity governance, risk management, and resilience programmes.
Related Microsoft certifications across Infrastructure, Azure, Security, or Enterprise Administration.
A resilient, secure, and high-performing infrastructure environment.
Clear alignment between infrastructure strategy and business objectives.
Successful delivery of transformation, modernization, and cloud initiatives.
Strong governance, risk management, and operational controls.
High-performing internal teams and effectively managed vendor relationships.
Trusted advisor status with senior technology and business stakeholders.
Annual leave and additional corporate benefits.
Opportunity to lead a large-scale enterprise infrastructure and cloud transformation agenda.
Significant exposure to senior leadership and strategic technology decision-making.
Manager - IT Infrastructure & Networks in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

d: We’re looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer I to help strengthen our security posture across applications, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to proactively identify risks, embed security by design, and drive resilience at scale. q: 5–8 years of relevant experience in application, cloud, or security engineering roles
Bachelor’s degree in Information Security , Computer Science, or a related field
Certifications in OSCP, OSCE, CDP is a plus
r: Ensure implementation of defined secure coding standards
Conduct manual code and architecture reviews
Embed security tools and controls into CI/CD pipelines
Partner with engineers to identify, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities
Perform white-box and black-box VAPT for web, mobile, and cloud/on-prem environments
Produce detailed security assessment reports and track mitigation actions to closure
Implement and maintain relevant cloud security tools
Strengthen cloud infrastructure against internal and external threats
Enhance security monitoring and detection across cloud environments
Follow established security policies, processes, and controls
Contribute to continuous improvement of security practices and frameworks
Promote a high-performance culture aligned with company values
